Name: (Deprecated) Map Teleport Compability for Ridgeside Village
Author: dizziRD
Description:
[heading]⚠️ (Deprecated) Map Teleport Compatibility for Ridgeside Village[/heading]
[i]This experiment is over. Use the one that works.[/i]
[quote]🛑 [b]No longer maintained.[/b] The teleport integration with Map Teleport did not work reliably, so this mod is [b]deprecated[/b].
✅ [b]Use this instead:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53419]Traveler’s Map: Compatibility with Ridgeside Village[/url]
Same goal (open the Ridgeside map and teleport to a zone), and it works.[/quote][line]
📌 Why this page still exists
It stays up so nobody who already installed it is left without an explanation. [b]Don’t install it on a new setup.[/b]
[line]
🗑️ Already installed?
[quote][list=1]
[*]Close the game[/*]
[*]Delete the mod folder from
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*]Install the Traveler’s Map version above[/*]
[/list][/quote][line]
🤝 [i]Map Teleport is by [b]aedenthorn[/b].[/i]

Manifest.Name: Ridgeside Map Button
Manifest.Description: Adds Ridgeside and East Scarp buttons to the vanilla world map. Ridgeside opens its own world map with clickable areas; East Scarp has no map of its own, so it opens a list of places. Both charge gold per trip (configurable).
Manifest.Author: dizziRD
